title: WOLS Specimen label
description: Normative for WOLS 1.5 (from 1.5.0-rc.1; where this schema and the specification prose differ, the schema wins). The embedded-format Specimen label. Every 1.4.0 label that is valid today stays valid. New members are optional, and 1.4 decoders treat them as unknown top-level members (a warning, not an error).

@context.description: JSON-LD context. The context document is served at this URL as application/ld+json (context/v1.jsonld).

version.description: Spec version the label was written against. Pre-release suffixes (1.5.0-rc.1) are allowed.

species.description: Scientific name as printed. Kept for 1.x compatibility; `taxon` carries identifiers and hybrids.

form.description: NEW in 1.5. The specific form within `type` (e.g. GRAIN_SPAWN within SPAWN). Replaces the lossy type-alias collapse.

derivedFrom.description: NEW in 1.5. Every parent specimen, with how it was used. When `strain.lineage` is also present it MUST equal the `id` of the first entry.

lot.description: NEW in 1.5. Traceability lot code (FSMA 204 TLC or a GS1 batch/lot, AI 10) for sellable product. Distinct from `batch`, which is a production grouping.

custom.description: Vendor namespaces. Each top-level key is a registered namespace.

signature.description: Ed25519 token `{kid}.{sig}` (spec grammar: kid 1-64 of ALPHA/DIGIT/-/_, sig 86 base64url chars). Kept as an opaque string here: a malformed token is a verification status (`malformed`), not a schema error, and decoders MUST preserve it.

SpecimenId.description: `wemush:` plus any non-empty suffix. Encoders that place it in a URL MUST percent-encode the suffix.

SpecimenForm.description: Open vocabulary. Registered values are listed; unregistered values MUST use a `x-` prefix.

Condition.description: NEW in 1.5. Health or terminal state, orthogonal to `stage`. Absent means ACTIVE.

Container.description: NEW in 1.5. The vessel, so vessel words stop being type aliases.

Taxon.description: NEW in 1.5. Name plus resolvable identifiers. For a hybrid, give `hybridOf` and set `scientificName` to the hybrid formula.

Strain.description: 1.5 makes `name` optional (generation without a named strain).

oneOf.description: Accepted from 1.3.0 Python labels; decoders read it as its decimal string and warn.

lineage.description: Primary parent. Kept for 1.x readers; see top-level `derivedFrom`.

source.description: How the strain was started. Free text in 1.x.

accession.description: NEW in 1.5. Culture-collection or vendor accession for the strain (e.g. a CCNo).

relation.description: SUBCULTURE increments clonalGeneration and transferDepth; EXPANSION and SPAWN_TO_BULK increment transferDepth only; CROSS starts a new filial generation.

unit.description: UCUM case-sensitive code, e.g. g, kg, [oz_av], [lb_av], mL, L, Cel, [degF], %, [ppm], lx, h, min, d. Legacy `C` and `F` are accepted for temperature.
